data.name: Fergus
data.long_meaning: The name Fergus is derived from the Old Irish word 'fer' meaning 'deer' and 'gos' meaning 'stranger'. This name was given to warriors in ancient Ireland, symbolizing strength, courage, and power in battle. Fergus is also a variant of the name Feargus, which means 'man of fear' or 'man of dread'.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes courage and strength in the face of challenges and adversities.

data.cultural_impact: The name Fergus has roots in the mythology and ancient history of Ireland. It was a popular name among the Irish warriors and chieftains, symbolizing strength, courage, and nobility. Fergus was also the name of several legendary figures in Irish folklore, such as Fergus mac Roich, a legendary poet and High King of Ireland, and Fergus son of Rudraige, a legendary warrior and king.
